Omni-Compass Live Engine

Left: native alone. Right: Omni-Compass on top of native: a supervisory governor, the control plane that sits on top of the native controllers and never replaces them. Sixty muscles of a stacked organism from the 1,107-muscle catalog. By default the body is the engine's own realms harness, replayed decision by decision on runs A, B and C: its plants, its native controllers and its max, each muscle alone (as the preregistered muscle table runs it) or all sixty as one organism. The brain reads it through nine senses and runs the six-state engine of omni-v8, the engine that stands. The distance of each muscle from the ring is its position in its own compass band.

The key: GAIN, EVEN and LOSS

Every result on this page is one of three words. The word says which way it went for the work; the number beside it is only the size, never a direction. The word is decided by what the gauge is for, never by the plus or minus sign of its number.

GAING Growth (asset appreciation); A Advantage (risk reduction); I Improvement (margin expansion); N Net-positive (profitable outcome)the gauge moved toward its declared aim against native: more work done, a shorter wait, fewer misses or failures, or a resource cut
EVENE Equalized (zero variance); V Verified baseline (expected norm); E Equilibrium (balanced risk); N Neutral (no net change)native and Omni could not be told apart: the same, or no difference beyond the noise; a knob native already runs at the top of its range is EVEN, at its limit on native
LOSSL Leakage (capital drain); O Off-track (adverse selection); S Setback (claim liability); S Subpar (negative variance)the gauge moved away from its declared aim: less work done, a longer wait, more misses or failures
power givena resource spent or held (energy, machines, memory, processor time, a bill) that rose: what Omni put in to buy the work and the speed shown beside it, always shown and never called a loss; one that fell is a cut, and a cut is GAIN

So "Misses: GAIN 35%" means Omni-Compass on top had 35% fewer misses than native; "Response time: GAIN 53%" means it answered 53% faster; "Energy: power given 0.01%" means it spent 0.01% more energy to do it. A miss is a decision where the work went over its line. The key is written once in tools/readings.py and stands at the top of the README, the reading guide and both manuals. GAIN, EVEN and LOSS, and the letters behind them, are The Omni-Compass LLC's own convention for reading its own results; the underwriting senses explain the words and are not an actuarial, financial or insurance opinion, and no outside body defined, reviewed or approved them. Run and scored by The Omni-Compass LLC's own code. No outside party has reviewed or approved these results.

The bottom line

  • Every view runs native alone first, then Omni-Compass on top of the same native, on the same load and seed. Each result below is written as the gauge, its word and its size (the key above).
  • Every muscle of the catalog on omni-v8 (section 3; the realms runner, ten seeds each, our own models). Of 1,107 muscles: 527 GAIN (493 on response time, 409 on misses, 33 on work), 159 EVEN (the same as native), 421 EVEN (at their limit on native), 0 LOSS under any load. All seven organisms read GAIN under each of their three loads: misses GAIN 1% to 9%; on the climb five of them read work GAIN too; not one plant inside any organism read LOSS. By stack: GPU hardware 11 GAIN and 11 at their limit of 22; the Linux kernel 9 GAIN of 20; Kubernetes workload scaling 24 GAIN of 32; cloud machines and capacity 20 GAIN of 21.
  • The engine's own harness, sixty muscles (section 1). Each muscle alone: misses GAIN 18% to 27% and the time to clear the waiting line GAIN 24% to 27%, in all three runs; work EVEN; 26 muscles move, 34 read EVEN (24 of them at their limit on native), none reads LOSS. One organism: misses GAIN 5% to 6%; everything else EVEN.
  • Where the brain steers. In the harness views the max acts muscle by muscle and the brain only reads the body. The brain steers every decision in the live controller (section 2): on its toy cluster every gauge reads EVEN over three runs.
  • Every stack, native and then on top (section 3, our own models). A GPU card: every gauge EVEN. At the max the card's own limit is already its top; at the tune-down the verdict tries one step down, measures the card's time per request there at LOSS 0.14% (AI work) and LOSS 0.91% (compute-bound), and refuses the step, so the card stays native. Under an operator's 105 W cap, compute-bound work: response time GAIN 8% to 11%; energy EVEN. Linux, one host: requests served GAIN 64%, response time GAIN 53%; host processor power given 31%, processor limit power given 167%; pod start wait LOSS 6% to 8% in this model (EVEN on real Kubernetes).
  • The receipts of the real runs (22 benchmarks, three runs each, section 3; the omni-v7 tables, whose engine omni-v8 keeps in 45 of 46 files byte for byte, until each benchmark's three runs on omni-v8 land): 210 rows GAIN, 38 power given, 509 EVEN, 25 LOSS, every one in CityLearn's small challenge districts (energy not served LOSS 2% to 10%, hour-to-hour swing, comfort, the highest peak), 11 where the runs disagree. On real Kubernetes (class L): 95th-percentile response time GAIN 52% to 75% on Goldilocks and KEDA and GAIN 54% to 58% on the Google 2011 day; EVEN on CruiseKube, fixed capacity and fairness. omni-v8's one change is the CityLearn wire (a battery whose building simulates outages stays native), the repair of those LOSS rows; its rerun is queued. No Azure, GPU or metal-CPU receipt yet.
  • Native's numbers, measured (docs/engine/NATIVE_REGISTER.md). The harness's native is round engineering figures, not product measurements. Against real defaults: power limits, CPU clocks and admission gates do ship at their top, so the max is right to leave them native there and their benefit is the same work for less energy (the GPU run on Lambda measures it); the HPA tolerance, its 300 s window and the cluster autoscaler's 10 minutes match; the harness's HPA target (70%) is tighter than the real runs' native (50%); axes, loops and batteries are not yet measured.

How to read it in thirty seconds

  1. Two engines, one demand. Left is native alone: the organism with only its native controllers. Right is Omni-Compass on top of native: the same organism and the same native controllers, the same demand at the same instant, with Omni-Compass on top. Nothing differs but Omni-Compass.
  2. Where a dot sits is how hard that muscle works. On its ring the muscle is at the center of its compass band, p = 0.5. Inward is calmer; outward is closer to its line (p = 1, the dashed red circle). Red means past the line: work is waiting or failing.
  3. All of it is the engine's code. The default body is the realms harness itself (realms/harness.py, plants.py, the max in compass_arm_v5.py), recorded by docs/engine/export_harness_trace.py; the brain, nerves, compass law and verdict are ported and checked number for number. A teaching model (class S, drawn for this page, and labelled so) can be switched on to stress the body by hand.

1 · The two engines, live

Every view is run twice on the same body, the same load and the same seed: native alone (left), then Omni-Compass on top of the same native (right). "One organism" is the sixty muscles in one body: the whole native organism on the left, the same organism with Omni-Compass on top on the right; "each muscle alone" runs each muscle native and then with Omni-Compass on top, one at a time. The counters under each ring and the scoreboard (section 5) give both arms and the difference. Where the two sides look the same, they are the same. Under the max a muscle is moved only where it has room above native; a muscle already at its limit on native (24 of these sixty) is left native by design, and inside one organism the bone (the power and cooling the whole body shares) holds most moves back. A dashed white ring marks every muscle that differs between the two sides at that moment; the counter under each ring counts them. In these harness views the max acts muscle by muscle and the brain at the center reads the body without steering it, as in the realms harness itself; section 2 shows the live controller, where the brain steers every decision.

2 · The live controller: the brain driving the cluster

This is the one place in the repository where the brain drives the muscles decision by decision: the shipped controller, omni_controller/controller.py, on the toy cluster of pilot/selfpilot.py, wired as the repository wires it. Each decision runs the chain left to right: the senses, the six-state brain, the nerves and the machine organ’s grant, the compass law on the service (cloud setting), the verdict’s trial, the release gate, the plug. Every value below is the controller’s own audit record of that decision, recorded by docs/engine/export_controller_trace.py on runs A, B and C (six hours each, a decision every 60 s, class S).

How each row is read: the paired change, native against Omni-Compass on top at the same decision, averaged over blocks of ten decisions so neighbouring decisions do not count twice, with its 95% interval (Student’s t over the blocks). This run: an interval that includes zero reads EVEN; clear of zero, the word follows the gauge’s aim (work: a rise is GAIN; misses, failed work, waiting: a fall is GAIN; energy or capacity held: a rise is power given, a fall a cut). Three runs (tools/readings.py): GAIN or LOSS only when all three runs point the same way with every interval clear of zero; EVEN when an interval includes zero; “the runs disagree” when clear runs point different ways. The spread of positions and the settings are shown, never judged: no rule of the engine aims at them. Run and scored by The Omni-Compass LLC's own code. No outside party has reviewed or approved these results.

6 · Inside the brain

The same state the cycle panel prints, drawn as the physics it is. Each ball is a live value of the Omni-Compass arm, integrated by RK4 every decision. Native has none of this: no state, no memory of need, no stress, no tide; each controller sees only its own reading, one to three decisions late.

U on the double well · eq. (2)

V(U) = −μ(U²/2 − U⁴/4) + (Ė/E_max)·U. A rising E tilts the well toward the failed basin.

S in its potential Φ · eqs. (5)–(6)

Φ(S) = α_s S²/2 + β_s S³/4 − δS. S rolls to S*; the senses pull it back each decision.

The bath B · eq. (7)

B̈ = γ_c δ S − (ω_B/Q_B) Ḃ − ω_B² B. The slow tide of physical load.

The nerves: four scalars multiply into calm

Native has no nerves: nothing grants or refuses a controller, and a blind sense or a security hold changes nothing it does.

κ convergence—
h basin health—
σ stress ratio S/S*—
ν unmet need—
calm—

calm = κ·h·(1 − (σ − 1)⁺)·(1 − min(ν, 1)). An organ may hand capacity back only when calm ≥ its θ, the line is clean and every sense is live; expanding stays allowed except under a security hold. Under the max, lifting off toward native never needs this grant; going below native does.

7 · The verdict: do no harm, measured

Before a knob moves one step past native, the step runs as a trial: costs at native first, then at the step. omni-v8 reads the change exactly as a report reads a row, on the log of each cost, with its 95% interval. Set what the step truly costs and watch the rule decide. It opens wired as the shipped Kubernetes controller is wired, on the noise the real runs measured.

a new trial starts on its own every few seconds

This trial

—

—

Over many trials at this cost

Native: its knob never moves past its own setting, so there is no trial and nothing to judge; every step Omni-Compass takes past native has to pass this test first. The medians alone allow a step when the trial's median is within the allowance of the reference's. omni-v8 (the rule first written in omni-v7) also refuses any step whose interval sits wholly above zero, measures on while the interval is wider than the allowance (up to three times the pieces measured each side), and keeps a step only if both estimates are inside the allowance. Ported from omnicompass/verdict.py; the costs are modelled (class S).

How each muscle wires it. The Kubernetes controller measures 200 requests each side against a 2% allowance (omni_controller/controller.py --verdict-samples 200 --allow 0.02), the cost being each request's response time. The noise is measured on the real runs of the omni-v7 tables (latency.csv, the spread of the log of the response time over windows of 200 requests): about σ 0.05 on the Google 2011 day, about σ 0.25 with the load swinging 1 to 8 (the all-four run). The GPU card measures 30 requests (gpu_compass.py --verdict-samples 30); in its model the card's own time per request carries no noise. The toy gate measures 60 (tools/toy_gate.py, σ 0.25). What the rule does there: on a steady day a step whose true cost is LOSS 3% is refused every time, and one at LOSS 1% half the time; with the load swinging, a step at LOSS 3% still passes about a quarter of the time and one at LOSS 5% about one time in twenty; with no noise any LOSS it can read is refused, even 0.1%. Above the verdict the max never goes below native at all, so in the default it never runs (section 2: no trial on top of the HPA).

8 · The parts of the drawing, each a line of the code

Items 1 to 5 and 8 are the engine’s code and run in every view. Items 6 and 7 as written (the compass law on each muscle, the plug’s lever) drive the teaching model; in the harness views the max and the plants’ own overrides take their place, and the live controller runs the compass law on the service as section 2 shows.

  1. 1

    Senses. The muscles' meters are read and normalised to nine observations: q, load, power, thermal, network, drift, stale, security, conflict. adapter.observe_vector. The inner arc of nine segments; steel particles run in along the wires.

  2. 2

    Assimilate. An observed state is formed and the engine is pulled toward it, x ← (1 − a)x + a·x_obs, a = 0.339. adapter.assimilate.

  3. 3

    Evolve. Equations (1) to (7), RK4, ten micro steps of 0.01, the controller evaluated, not applied (u = 0). core.macro_step. The six spokes at the center are E, U, I_U, S, B, Ḃ, each drawn on its own scale: E, U and I_U on [0, 1], S on [−1, 1], B on [−0.5, 1], Ḃ on [−0.5, 0.5].

  4. 4

    Allocate. push = clip(−f_U + 12(1 − U), ±25)/25 and ρ* = clamp(ρ₀ − k_I I_U − k_E E, ρ_min, ρ₀). adapter.Governor.step.

  5. 5

    Nerves. κ, h, σ, ν into calm; calm against each organ's θ grants contraction. nervous_system.scalars, authority, from_governor. On this page each body part answers to one organ: the spine to nodes (θ 0.7), compute to pods (0.5), physics to cpufreq (0.3), energy to power (0.3), distribution to routing (0.5).

  6. 6

    Compass. Each muscle's reading is placed in its band, p = (r − lo)/(hi − lo), and the force is F = A·tanh((k_p(p − ½) + k_d v)/A), failing up past 0.95, never handing back while it climbs above the center; k_d set for critical damping from the muscle's own τ. compass_law.CompassLaw.

  7. 7

    Plug. One wire in, one wire out: each write is clipped to the cover; the snapshot taken once at the start is what reset restores. The engine’s plug also reads each write back and stops if someone else moved the lever; the page’s model takes every write as landed. The kill switch hands every lever to native at once. compass_law.Plug, master.py.

  8. 8

    The verdict. In the live controller, the trigger that keeps a step past native only when it costs nothing; in the realms harness the same rule is kept by the twin and the bone (nothing below native, nothing past the line’s room). No step past native is kept unless its trial reads no LOSS and its cost sits inside the allowance. verdict.Verdict, judge="interval".

The teaching model, written out (class S, drawn for this page)

one decision, muscle i, in this order                              both arms meet the same demand dᵢ(t)
cᵢ ← cᵢ + (Lᵢ − cᵢ)(1 − e^(−1/τᵢ))                                 capacity follows its lever with response τᵢ
wᵢ = dᵢ + bᵢ,   servedᵢ = min(wᵢ, cᵢ),   bᵢ ← 0.85 (wᵢ − servedᵢ)     the 15% of waiting work that leaves is failed work
rᵢ = wᵢ / cᵢ;   r̂ᵢ = rᵢ read kᵢ decisions late (kᵢ = 1 to 3)         past the line when rᵢ > 1
native   L* = cᵢ r̂ᵢ / 0.70, held inside ±10%, at most doubled per decision, scale-down only to the largest of the
         last 5 proposals, clip [c_min, c_max] = [0.35 wᵢ, 11 wᵢ] with wᵢ the muscle's share of demand
compass  pᵢ = (r̂ᵢ − 0.2)/0.8,   Fᵢ = the compass law above with τᵢ, dt = 1 decision
the max  L ← Lᵢ(1 + 0.30 Fᵢ) if Fᵢ > 0 and the organ may expand;  toward L* by min(1, 0.15 + 0.5|Fᵢ|) if Fᵢ < 0;
         L ← max(L, L*)                                             never below native
tune-down L ≤ L* always; a step L ← max(0.85 L*, Lᵢ(1 + 0.10 Fᵢ)) only if Fᵢ < 0, pᵢ < 0.40, the organ may contract,
         nothing waits, native has not risen for 3 decisions, |vᵢ| < 0.05 and r̂ᵢ cᵢ / L ≤ ρ*  (the release gate)
plug     Lᵢ ← clip(L, c_min, c_max);  a write is counted when L moves more than 2% and differs from L* by more than 2%
kill     Lᵢ ← L* at once (native alone)

What is the engine's code

The six-state engine, its constants and RK4 integrator, the assimilation, push and ρ*, the four nerve scalars and the organ thresholds, the compass law and the verdict in words are ported from omnicompass/core.py, adapter.py, nervous_system.py, compass_law.py and verdict.py at commit c8ba7775d, all inside the omni-v8 fingerprint (the same bytes as omni-v7's: omni-v8 changed only tools/run_citylearn.py). Checked against the Python on seeded inputs (docs/engine/check_live_engine.py): 8,000 decisions of the governor (state, push, ρ*, κ, h, σ, ν, calm), 48,000 organ grants, 4,800 compass forces, 300 verdict intervals and 400 full verdict trials. Largest difference 2 × 10⁻¹⁵, zero mismatched grants, zero mismatched verdicts. The harness views are not ported: they are the harness’s own record, made by its code.

The two bodies

The realms harness (the default). The sixty muscles are one organism of realms/harness.py: each a plant of realms/plants.py (machine pools under their autoscalers, cooled zones, batteries on their lines, motion axes, process loops), coupled through their heat and their power, under the climb (1 2 3 2 3 4 …), 240 decisions of 15 s. Omni-Compass on top is the max of realms/compass_arm_v5.py with the body’s bone, its twins and the muscles’ cards; at 80% the brain goes silent and the lease walks every setting back to native over 24 decisions. Recorded on seeds 3000, 3001 and 3002 (runs A, B and C) by docs/engine/export_harness_trace.py; the page replays the record. Each muscle alone is the same harness one muscle at a time, as run_muscle_arm runs the preregistered muscle table: under the line (work waiting at the start), the max with the muscle's own twin, the lease after 80%; each muscle's decisions are laid on 240 frames (a frame shows the last decision it covers and reads over the line if any of them was). In that harness the brain’s state is computed from the body’s aggregate, as a governor reads it, and shown; the max itself acts muscle by muscle. The teaching model. A drawing model, evidence class S. Sixty muscles named from the 1,107-muscle catalog (twelve each from the spine and the four realms), each a capacity lever with its own response time τ and sensing delay, under an HPA-style native controller (target 0.70, 10% tolerance, five-decision scale-down window). Demand climbs 1 2 3 2 3 4, surges, eases and idles over six hours, the same for both arms. The lever rules that turn F into a write are this page's, written out above and kept inside the doctrine: under the max never below native, lifting off hands back toward native; on the tune-down never above native, and below it only with the organ's grant and the release gate.
